privacy.agent_customer_duty.text: You're responsible for your customers' data. Tell each customer you keep their details in Agent PRO to manage their policies, and keep only what you need, deleting enquiries you no longer need. You can share a privacy note with them from their page.
privacy.agent_customer_duty.title: Your customers' data
privacy.agent_signup.account_data: Email and password (stored hashed by Supabase Auth)
privacy.agent_signup.billing_kept: 8 years after the financial year, anonymised after account deletion (law)
privacy.agent_signup.board: If you're not satisfied, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India.
privacy.agent_signup.consent: I'm 18 or older, and I agree to the Terms and the Privacy notice.
privacy.agent_signup.customers_note: Your customers' data: you decide why the enquiries and customers you add are used and how long they're kept. Agent PRO stores them securely in India for you and deletes nothing automatically. Delete what you no longer need; everything is deleted with your account.
privacy.agent_signup.customers_purpose: You decide the purpose; we store them for you as your processor
privacy.agent_signup.grievance: Grievance officer: {GRIEVANCE_OFFICER_NAME}, {GRIEVANCE_EMAIL}, {GRIEVANCE_PHONE}. We reply within 30 days.
privacy.agent_signup.intro: Agent PRO is responsible for the data about you and your account. This notice lists what we keep, why, and for how long.
privacy.agent_signup.lapsed: If your plan lapses, your account and its data are deleted 12 months later. We remind you 30 days, 7 days and 48 hours before; renewing before then cancels the deletion.
privacy.agent_signup.no_ads: No ads, no trackers, and we never sell your data.
privacy.agent_signup.processors: Who processes it for us: Supabase (database and sign-in; data stored in Mumbai, India), Cloudflare (hosting your website), Razorpay (payments; its Android checkout also collects device data), an email service ({EMAIL_PROVIDER}) for account emails and, if you buy a domain, the domain registrar and registry. Supabase and Cloudflare staff may access data from outside India for support.
privacy.agent_signup.profile_data: Name, mobile, designation, city, company, optional photo, agency code
privacy.agent_signup.profile_purpose: Your profile and your public website (only what you publish is public)
privacy.agent_signup.registrant_kept: Until 90 days after your last domain ends
privacy.agent_signup.registrant_purpose: Registering your domain (shared with the registrar and registry)
privacy.agent_signup.rights: In Settings → Your data you can download, correct or delete your data and nominate someone to act for you.
privacy.agent_signup.session_purpose: Keeping you signed in (encrypted with the Android Keystore)
privacy.agent_signup.title: Privacy notice
privacy.agent_signup.withdraw: You can withdraw this consent only by deleting your account, because the service can't run without it.
privacy.enquiry_form.consent: I agree that {name} may use these details to contact me about insurance. I'm 18 or older.
privacy.enquiry_form.how_long: How long: until {name} deletes it, which they should do once it's no longer needed. You can ask them to delete it at any time.
privacy.enquiry_form.rights: Your rights: withdraw your consent, see, correct or delete your data, or nominate someone, by contacting {name} ({phone}, {email}) or with the form on this page. If you're not satisfied, contact Agent PRO's grievance officer ({GRIEVANCE_OFFICER_NAME}, {GRIEVANCE_EMAIL}); you can also complain to the Data Protection Board of India.
privacy.enquiry_form.title: How your data is used
privacy.enquiry_form.what: What: your name and mobile number; optionally your email, the kind of plan you're interested in, and your message.
privacy.enquiry_form.who: Who: {name} is responsible for your data. Agent PRO stores it securely in India on their behalf.
privacy.enquiry_form.why: Why: so {name}, an insurance advisor, can reply and advise you about insurance. Nothing else; not sold; not shared with an insurance company without your agreement.
privacy.guardian_consent.consent: A parent or guardian has agreed
privacy.guardian_consent.notice: Customer is under 18 — record a parent's or guardian's consent
privacy.guardian_consent.title: Parent or guardian consent
site.form_error_consent: Please tick the box to agree before sending.
site.form_error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
site.form_message_hint: Please don't include health or bank details.
site.form_rate_limited: You've already sent a request. {name} will be in touch.
site.form_thank_you: Thank you — {name} will contact you soon
site.legal_draft: Draft pending legal review. Not yet in force.
site.legal_pending: This section is being finalised with legal advice.
site.not_available_text: The link may be wrong, or the page is not published.
site.policy_changes_text: When this policy changes we update this page and tell advisors in the app.
site.policy_collect: What we collect, why and for how long
site.policy_enquirers_text: If you send an enquiry through an advisor's website, that advisor is responsible for your data. The privacy page of their website explains how it is used and how to make a request.
site.policy_who_text: Agent PRO is an app and website builder for independent insurance advisors. Agent PRO is responsible for the data of advisors who use it. For enquiries sent through an advisor's website, the advisor is responsible and Agent PRO stores the data for them.
site.privacy_fiduciary: {name} is the data fiduciary (the person responsible) for the details shared on this website. Agent PRO provides the website and stores the data on their behalf.
site.privacy_how_text: Use the form below, or contact {name} directly. {name} replies by phone and may call you back on the number you give to check it's you.
site.request_kind: What would you like to do?
site.request_note: We use these details only to handle your request.
site.request_rate_limited: You've already sent a request today. {name} will be in touch.
site.request_sent: Thank you. {name} has your request and will call you on the number you gave.
